boundaries.label: The mechanism — legibility in, brain out
The people — who does the work

cards.title: The mechanism is a triangle
items: Input: Organizational Legibility. If an action was not recorded, it did not happen to the AI; raw recordings must be synthesized down because no context window holds an org's history.
Unit of work: a Self-Improving AI Loop, a process wrapped in a closed feedback loop that fixes its own failures. Fix the Principle, Not the Example keeps it learning instead of accumulating patches.
Output: the Company Brain. Business context and skills are the durable asset; accumulated context compounds into the moat under the company.

cards.title: The people
items: Role Archetypes: hire for judgment because models supply throughput; boundaries blur, but every agent workflow keeps a named human owner.
Founder as Orchestrator and Everyone Ships are the same shift at two scales: whoever understands the problem ships the first version.
Prototype, Dogfood, Productionize is the path an internal tool takes to become product. Startup Lifecycle remaps the four stages on the same premise.

cards.title: Where the tensions are
items: One intelligence layer or a mesh: AI-Native Company says the layer replaces middle management's routing; Company Brain carries a contested, low-confidence claim that large orgs get a mesh of sources of truth. An account of an org past a few hundred people would settle it.
Disposable software, durable context: Build for Rebuilding and Company Brain only agree if code and context are kept strictly apart. No page states that separation as its own claim.
Roles blur, owners stay: which roles survive past the first version is not stated.

cards.title: Sourcing
items: Startup Lifecycle rests on one vendor ebook; Founder as Orchestrator and Everyone Ships on vendor-curated testimonials. Their supported status is weaker than it reads.
Prototype, Dogfood, Productionize has no claim callout at all.
Strongest: the two high-confidence legibility claims. Most in doubt: one layer or a mesh.

cards.title: This KB is an instance
items: This KB is a company brain for one domain, and its ingest loop is a self-improving loop with a human in it.
Its Three-Layer Architecture (raw, wiki, schema) is one instance of keeping durable context apart from disposable code.
